summary: Dispatcher's finalAgentMessage/assistantTurnText re-derive the same NDJSON line-parse and message.content block-walk that Agent.ts's renderStreamJsonLine already implements for terminal rendering.

per.section: The fix lands at the mechanism

tests.asserts: the extracted NDJSON-event-parse and content-blocks-of-type helpers are used by both renderStreamJsonLine (tool_use blocks) and a stand-in caller shaped like Dispatcher's text-block extraction - a one-sided change to either consumer's block-type filter doesn't touch the shared parse

acceptance: One shared pair of helpers in src/Agent.ts parses an NDJSON line and extracts message.content blocks by type; both withTerminalRenderer's renderStreamJsonLine and Dispatcher's finalAgentMessage/assistantTurnText call them instead of re-deriving the parse; tests/Dispatcher.test.ts:2985-3132 stays green unchanged; tsc/vitest green.
notes: Sweep finding, tests/Dispatcher.test.ts neighborhood (Agent.ts read as its import). Re-verified this tick past 56d2c4e0's insert: Agent.ts:358-377 and Dispatcher.ts:2740-2789 both JSON.parse a line, check .type, and for "assistant" walk message.content[] by block .type - one keeps tool_use (rendering), the other text (bail message). Agent.ts already owns stream-json awareness via the decorator; re-deriving the parse in Dispatcher.ts is the duplication, not the awareness.
